entities.name: Isamaru
entities.description: The great white Akita dog of daimyo Takeshi Konda, companion of Michiko.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Daimyo who trained Isamaru and neglected him after his crime.

entities.name: Michiko
entities.description: Konda's daughter, Isamaru's companion, locked in her room after her journey to Jukai.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: Arrived to free Michiko and later transported Isamaru to Jukai.

entities.name: Akki horde
entities.description: Horde that assailed the Towabara plains.

entities.name: Constable Aoyama
entities.description: Tried to prevent Toshi from stealing a battle moth.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Place Michiko journeyed to and where Isamaru was taken.

entities.name: Towabara
entities.description: Plains where Toshi came for a battle moth.

events.summary: Isamaru is present when Toshi Umezawa arrives to free Michiko from her locked room.
events.quote: Isamaru was present when Toshi Umezawa arrived to free Michiko from her room

events.summary: As O-Kagachi approaches Eiganjo, General Takeno releases Isamaru from the gates; he helps the evacuees fight the akki horde.
events.quote: General Takeno released Isamaru from the gates of the castle

events.summary: Toshi wills himself into the shadows and transports Isamaru to Jukai near Michiko.
events.quote: transported Isamaru to Jukai, near Michiko's position

relations.quote: the great white Akita dog of daimyo Takeshi Konda

relations.note: Found a great companion in her.
relations.quote: He found a great companion in Michiko.
